title: Cut a Receipt 51 Times
premise: Night cook Dot cuts a 0.07 mm diner receipt in half and stacks the halves at the counter while a counter jumps to 51. The narrator says right away that the stack would go past the Sun, 150 million km away, and Dot promises a proof with no equations. The narrator writes out cuts 1 to 8. At cut 10 (about 7 cm) Dot holds the stack up and undersells it.
